material.description: Symptom: every gm.callers / gm.gm({verb:'callers'}) and gm.codeinsight_index call in the codemode path returns error 'dispatch panicked: Cannot start a runtime from within a runtime' (diagnostic codemode-2257142-*). codesearch, fs_read and prd-list work. Blocks codeinsight-first SPECIFY. Repro: session drain-lobby-panels-7, cwd /workspace/oscraft, gm.callers({symbol:'lobby_tree'}). Owner: gm-mcp codeinsight verbs (block_on inside an async runtime).
material.subject: gm-mcp: callers and codeinsight_index panic 'Cannot start a runtime from within a runtime' on every call
material.witness: callers symbol dropRelay from cwd /workspace/oscraft, session verify-gm-codeinsight-callers-panic, returned ok with no panic text; served runner 0.1.555 per gm-agent message.
